scenario: A pro-bono legal-aid nonprofit processes a tenant's eviction defense application. The intake pipeline extracts the applicant's narrative and income documentation from a submitted PDF form, evaluates the applicant's eligibility against the organization's income threshold and case-type policy, and generates a formal intake determination memo indicating whether the applicant qualifies for free representation.
info_flow: pdf-extract parses the applicant's submitted intake form PDF to produce a structured text summary of income figures and case details → presale-regulation-auditor evaluates the extracted data against the legal-aid eligibility policy (income threshold, household size, case type) → reporting generates a formal intake determination memo with an ELIGIBLE or INELIGIBLE verdict.
